_about: Identities whose code pull requests the CLA check lets through without a signature. Matched on the numeric user ID, never the login. Every entry needs a reason a reader can check. A GitHub role (owner, member, collaborator) is NOT a reason: it grants access, not rights in the work ([jura], 2026-10-28). Bots belong here only when their changes are machine-generated; a bot that lands a patch a person wrote would bypass the agreement. A person covered by a Corporate CLA is NOT an exemption: an agreement exists, so they belong in legal/corporate-signatures.md ([jura], docs b527055). Read from the base branch, so a pull request that edits this file only takes effect once merged.

exemptions.reason: Machine-generated dependency updates: version bumps and lockfile changes, no human-authored content.
